# gitmoap_provider_submissions (Data Source)

List a provider's submissions. Every submission made for the provider, across its versions, with each one's state. Answers `404` for a provider that does not exist. Only the publisher that owns the provider and platform administrators may list them.

The token needs `provider_publishing:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) Provider id

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `provider_id` (String)
- `publisher_id` (String)
- `state` (String) Where a provider submission stands, from review through to publication or refusal.
- `submission_id` (String)
- `submitted_at` (String)
- `version` (String)
